item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We must treat this as a national security priority—not a distant technology debate.

2. We cannot defend our countries with yesterday’s assumptions. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most nations will lose the ability to protect themselves. We need international action before that power takes hold.

3. We reject a future in which most countries cannot defend themselves. That is the future we face if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years. We must put security ahead of the race to build it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe a basic responsibility of every country is to protect its people. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, most countries will lose the ability to defend themselves. We cannot accept that outcome, and we cannot afford to treat it as a distant concern. We must confront what this technology means for sovereignty, security and the balance of power. Our priority is clear: prevent a race toward superintelligence from stripping nations of their capacity to protect their citizens. We will press for international coordination and binding safeguards that put collective security before technological competition. We must act before that capacity is lost.
